## POST `/api/instances/esrsParam/{id}/action/modify`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Modify ESRS settings. Enable, disable or change Remote Support options.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | Unique identifier of the Remote Support instance. --eng This value is always 0, because at any given time there can only one remote support solution enabled. |

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | Enable or disable Remote Support. Values are: true - Enable Remote Support false - Disable Remote Support |
| `esrsVeAddress` | string (IPv6 supported: false, Prefix-length supported: false, Port supported: true, DNS name supported: true) | Primary Centralized ESRS gateway, SAE or SCG appliance. |
| `secondaryEsrsVeAddress` | string (IPv6 supported: false, Prefix-length supported: false, Port supported: true, DNS name supported: true) | Secondary Centralized ESRS gateway, SAE or SCG appliance. If a port is not specified the following default port of 9443 will be used. |
| `isCentralized` | boolean | Type of Remote Support Values are: true - Centralized Remote Support false - Integrated Remote Support |

**Responses:** `204` No Content
